structured.answer: I'd take option A, the one tall column with the words and amounts beside each part and the big "66,513 ₪ נשאר בידיים" under it. You read it top to bottom like a bank slip. B spreads the money over four or five separate columns, and the tax minus sits by itself in red stripes and scares me off.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the explanation under the small picture
stuck.why: It says 'S&P500', 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד', 'קרן מחקה', '(4D)'. English letters and index words I don't know. For a moment I thought this was about shares and not for me.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the first column at 5 years
stuck.why: The first thing I saw was '−13,974 ₪ מס במשיכה' in red stripes, and I got a fright. Only after a while did I see 'מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס'. On screen 3 the tax is '0 ₪'.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the sentence 'כל שקל שהפקדתם נהיה 3.70 ₪ בקרן'
stuck.why: I wasn't sure how one shekel turns into 3.70. Then I understood it counts the employer's part too.
Each part has its own column, at a different height, and I had to follow the dotted lines from one to the next. The small numbers under the columns are hard to read.

used: The heading 'קרן השתלמות' and the tabs 'שכירים / עצמאים'
'לפני 6 שנים: מס' and 'מ-6 שנים: פטור ממס'
The big numbers 66,513 ₪ and 98,738 ₪ under 'נשאר בידיים', against 19,595 ₪ and 23,973 ₪
The words 'מומלץ' next to option A
skimmed: The small bar chart of years 1 to 12 at the top of each picture
The description under option B's heading
skipped: The small picture on the first screen: tiny dots and a table, I couldn't read it
The small grey lines at the bottom of each picture (19 מסלולים, דמי ניהול 0.7%, 14 תעריפים...)
The line about the fund names and the S&P
unsure_meaning: 'מיטב השתלמות עוקב מדד', 'קרן מחקה', 'מדד' in that sense
'חשבון ניירות ערך': I don't know what it is or why it's compared
'רווח אחרי דמי ניהול': how much the fees take, I didn't see
The dashed, striped colours: pink, turquoise and orange are close, and I couldn't tell which part goes with which
'⚠' in orange on the example line
not_found: A plain sentence saying 'yes, it's worth joining'
How much the management fee takes in shekels, in plain words
Whether you can lose money in the fund, and how safe it is compared with a deposit

findings.what: The tax minus '−13,974 ₪' in red stripes is the first thing the eye catches, and it scares you before you see it disappears after 6 years
findings.where: Screen 2 (option A at 5 years) and screen 4 (option B)

findings.what: Dark background with small grey text; the small lines at the bottom and the picture on the first screen are unreadable even enlarged
findings.where: Screen 1 and the bottom of every picture

findings.what: English letters and investment words (S&P500, קרן מחקה, עוקב מדד) right on the first screen make it feel like a page about shares
Option B: lots of separate columns with small labels underneath, and you have to follow the dotted lines between them
Pink, orange and turquoise in stripes are hard to tell apart
findings.where: The top of the columns in both options

findings.what: It never says plainly whether you can lose money and how safe it is
The small chart of 12 years at the top of each picture is busy and unclear
